g.text: PawLocal · Implementation sequence & gates
Ten issue-linked packages • implementation authorized; live applies and activation require their recorded gates
OWNER-APPROVED MVP CONTRACT | 23 OCT 2026 | #239 · #59 → #42
1 SPECIFY / RECONCILE READINESS
P0 #222 + #239 contract
Approved architecture, exact sources, contracts, current readiness and review evidence.
Open #43 is not acceptance evidence; unmerged PR #182 does not silently renumber stages.
2 CONFIGURE / PROVISION GRAFANA
P1: public YAML copy + tag reader; missing warns/skips; consuming workflows enforce needs.
P2: reproducible Grafana account/region/Free provisioning + actual endpoint settings.
3 ENABLE DIRECT TELEMETRY
FastAPI OTLP + React Faro; runtime-only token; privacy and bounded fail-open export.
Coordinate release flags, public build snapshots, manifests and evidence validators.
4 ACCEPT MONITORING / G1
Six reproducible dashboards + one synthetic journey alert; quotas / isolation / disable proof.
G1 gates initial responder activation. P8 production monitoring follows one-time authorized setup.
5 IMPLEMENT CLOUD RESPONSE
P5 intake depends on P1. P6 fixer/review/publish/merge/promote needs #239 + P1 + P5 schema.
Mocks can develop in parallel; exact HMAC/dispatch boundary + isolated trusted publication.
6 ACCEPT DEVELOPMENT REPAIR / G2
Alert → test/fix → fresh verdict → PR/CI → auto merge → verified dev release.
Prove duplicates, stale/resolved races, dispatch loss, failed review, timeout and escalation.
7 OBSERVE PROD / AUTO RECOVER
P8 monitoring depends on P4/G1. P9 automatic production recovery needs P7/G2 + P8.
One-time read/setup authority; exact dev-verified release → auto promote → recovery.
CODE / APPLY / ACTIVATION ARE SEPARATE MILESTONES
Initial infrastructure setup needs approval; runtime applies are machine-gated release-only. Existing states; secrets stay outside state.
G1/G2 are setup acceptance. Runtime is automatic; 20 min to PR + proposed 60 min CI→recovery.
